content.title: DISTRIBUTED PROCESSING & SCALING
content.content:
- **Horizontal node scaling**: Additional Ground Plex worker nodes are added to the existing Snaplex group and immediately begin receiving pipeline workloads. No architecture change or Snaplex group configuration update required (horizontal PXP scales-out via incremental Pod deployments on OpenShift; node count is not pre-configured — autoscaling is natively supported.

- **Vertical scaling (per-node resources)**: CPU and memory resources per Ground Plex pod are configurable via Helm values. Increasing node resources raises the concurrency capacity (simultaneous pipeline executions per node).

- **Ultra-Pipeline throughput**: Ultra-Pipeline — SnapLogic's high-performance streaming execution mode — sustain billions of records per day on appropriately-sized Ground Plex deployments. SnapLogic PS provides sizing guidance based on AH's expected data volumes, peak throughput requirements, and pipeline complexity.

- **Pipeline concurrency**: Multiple JCC containers per Ground Plex node can be configured to increase the number of simultaneously running pipelines. Concurrency is configurable at the Snaplex and per-node level.
